name: Rehabilitation Science PhD
detailsNote: Official available requirements. December 1 is published without a year; Fall 2027 deadline not confirmed. Funding amounts have no stated academic year unless noted; confirm offer. Admission model omitted unless directly established.

english.toefl: 79 with W21/R19 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 total/W/R on or after
english.note: IELTS reading/writing 6.5; Fall 2027 DET total/reading/writing 120. Scores within two years of start. Twin Cities does not accept TOEFL MyBest; IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted. Education exemption: secondary school in US/listed country, or 16 semester/24 quarter non-ESL postsecondary credits completed within past two years while living in US/listed country. Program may require higher scores.

applicationFee.note: US citizen/PR $75, international $95; nonrefundable. Central office does not waive fees. GSDO conditional route: US citizen/PR seeking first graduate degree with qualifying listed participation; request before submission/payment. Medical School may offer limited domestic waivers; confirm program procedure.

documents: Three recommendations (letters no longer than two pages)
requirements.note: Related bachelor/equivalent (e.g. biomedical engineering, kinesiology, health fields); application page prefers undergraduate/graduate GPA 3; program homepage calls 3.00 the operational minimum, so plan for at least 3 and confirm any exception. Prerequisite deficiencies may be assigned. Agreed PhD-holding faculty adviser required before matriculation; contact before applying. Quantitative mentors may request evidence via coursework or quantitative GRE. No writing sample or separate research description.

funding.note: Funding is not guaranteed; RA/TA depends on positions, funds, academic progress and assistantship performance. Program prioritizes full-time PhD students. Undated full-time employment starts at $31.98/hour or $33,259 annually for 12 months, with tuition and health coverage minus a small premium; university fees are not covered. Lower appointments have prorated pay/benefits. December 1 maximizes funding consideration.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application/funding priority
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated annual deadline. Later applications may be considered for Rehabilitation Science; confirm cycle.
